Baron Callem Bormul is a noble of Baldur's Gate who is present for  Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city.
“
Archduke - quite something, don't you think? I daresay Balduran himself would approve.
„
— Callem Bormul

Involvement

Before the ceremony he sits among other patriars on the pews in central nave of the Audience Hall.

After the ceremony ends, Lord Bormul moves to the southern nave of the Audience Hall and stands near the first table with refreshments. If spoken to, he says that, in his opinion, Balduran himself would approve current course of events.

If the party choose to confront Gortash, they can later find Lord Bormul along with all other invited guests and their retinue – slaughtered in the Audience Hall.
